android.desc:
AudioRun is a GPS running tracker that provides detailed real-time audio feedback while you're running. Get notified of your pace, heartrate, distance, intervals and much more, at a frequency you decide. No ads, no accounts, no analytics, no nonsense. Just a great, fully featured running tracker. 

Heart-rate sensors
Pairs with Bluetooth and ANT+ chest straps.

Automatic Route and Segment detection
Your runs are automatically matched against previous runs, so you can compare your pace against earlier efforts.

Offline maps
Download maps and run without needing internet access

Dark mode
Light and dark mode is supported.

AI coaching, on your terms
An optional coach that knows your recent runs and your goals can coach you through runs and help you stay motivated. Set your training goals and let the coach guide you while you run. 

Strava integration
Upload a run to Strava with one tap. 

Indoor mode
Indoor mode for treadmill runs can be enabled

No accounts, no ads
Just like it says: AudioRun just works from the moment you open the app. No login, no ads, no analytics. 

Your data is yours to keep
AudioRun allows you to export your runs to GPX files, and has a full local backup/restore sessions feature.

Designed for accessibility
The app works with TalkBack, and offers a high-contrast visual mode for increased accessibility for vision impaired users. Audio voices are customizable - pick among many different voices and control the speech rate
